methods.label: Check the signs
methods.explanation:
The positive coefficients let us rule out positive roots without solving the cubic. For every \(x\geq 0\), the variable terms are nonnegative, so
\[
x^3+6x^2+11x+6\geq 6>0.
\]
Thus no nonnegative number can satisfy the equation. There is a negative real root, since substituting \(x=-1\) gives
\[
-1+6-11+6=0.
\]
This also rules out the choices claiming no negative roots or no real roots. The equation has no positive real roots, choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
methods.levelReason: Only signs of powers, elementary inequalities, and substitution are needed.
